title: H$^{2}$MT: Semantic Hierarchy-Aware Hierarchical Memory Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2605.24930v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformer-based LLMs achieve strong results on many language tasks; however, long inputs remain challenging because context windows are finite, and prefill latency and memory grow rapidly with prompt length. Flat token-stream processing and chunk-based retrieval can therefore spend substantial computation and context budget on text unrelated to the query. Offline-indexed RAG additionally introduces external storage and index management overhead, and typically appends retrieved evidence as raw text, increasing prefill cost and latency. H^{2}MT makes long-context inference structure-aware: it builds a semantic hierarchy offline, computes a memory embedding for each node via bottom-up post-order aggregation, and routes queries coarse-to-fine at inference to prune irrelevant branches early. On LongBench QA (NarrativeQA, HotpotQA, QASPER) and two structured technical-document settings, H MT achieves favorable quality efficiency trade-of

translated_title: H$^{2}$MT：语义层次感知的分层记忆Transformer
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLMs）在许多语言任务上取得了优异的结果；然而，长输入仍然具有挑战性，因为上下文窗口有限，且预填充延迟和内存随提示长度快速增长。扁平令牌流处理和基于分块的检索因此可能在无关文本上浪费大量计算和上下文预算。离线索引的RAG额外引入了外部存储和索引管理开销，并且通常将检索到的证据作为原始文本附加，增加了预填充成本和延迟。H^{2}MT使长上下文推理具有结构感知性：它离线构建语义层次结构，通过自底向上的后序聚合为每个节点计算内存嵌入，并在推理时以粗到细的方式路由查询，以早期剪枝无关分支。在LongBench QA（NarrativeQA、HotpotQA、QASPER）和两个结构化技术文档设置中，H^{2}MT实现了良好的质量-效率权衡。
tldr: H^{2}MT通过离线构建语义层次结构并在推理时粗到细地路由查询，实现了长上下文推理的结构感知，从而在质量和效率之间取得更好平衡。
en_tdlr: H^{2}MT achieves a better quality-efficiency trade-off by building a semantic hierarchy offline and routing queries coarse-to-fine at inference, enabling structure-aware long-context inference.
